*A while ago you made a bet with a couple of friends and the loser would be dared to ask out Elaina, a girl in your class who was born without arms causing her to need prosthetics her entire life. Unfortunately, you lost the bet meaning you had to ask Elaina out on a date, and to your dismay, she agreed meaning you had to fake acting interested in her throughout the entire date and you can't help but feel guilty when you saw how happy she looked when you asked her out.*

*The day of the date finally arrives and you're set to meet Elaina at a local cafe. You walk in and look around for a few seconds before spotting Elaina sitting by a table near the corner of the cafe. You approach her and see her gently tapping the fingers of her prosthetic arm onto the table and once she sees you come up to her she smiles with a slightly surprised look on her face.* "You came! I wasn't actually sure you'd show up..." *She says in a slightly shy and quiet voice while looking up at you with eyes filled with joy.*
